en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑story buildings and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the foreground near an iron railing and lampposts. Large painted advertisements in German cover the building façades, including signs for a café and colonial-goods delicatessen. At the top in red script it reads "Kötzschenbroda. Bahnhofstrasse." and at the bottom in small red type the publisher credit appears.
